theorems.name: Submission.rectifiability_bf_limsup_sup_measurable
theorems.statement: ∀ (Z Y : Type) [MeasurableSpace Z] [MeasurableSpace Y] (k : ℕ) (μ : Measure Y) (δ : ℝ) (G : ℝ → ℝ → Set (Z × Y)), SFinite μ → (∀ r s, MeasurableSet (G r s)) → (∀ r s s', s ≤ s' → G r s ⊆ G r s') → (∀ r s, 0 < r → G r s = ⋃ r' ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) r, G r' s) → Measurable (fun z : Z => limsup (fun s : ℝ => ⨆ r ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) δ, μ {y | (z, y) ∈ G r s} / ENNReal.ofReal ((r * s) ^ k)) (𝓝[>] 0))
